what: Hovering a row in the big word list dims the other rows to .2 (.5s), and a square photo box (320px) opens from the center via clip-path in .8s power4.out, following the cursor with its center on it and lagging .6s (power3). Inside the box, that row’s photos flip in hard cuts every .5s (black and white). On leave it waits .2s, then closes toward the center in .2s. Moving straight to another row doesn’t close it, only the photo set swaps.

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Hover rows (children) — paired with group in order
options.[data-fx-part=box]: Following photo box (child, one) — fixed to the screen
options.[data-fx-part=group]: Photo groups per row inside the box — row i ↔ group i (last group if short), the group’s children are the photos that slide
options.open: Duration for the box to open (sec), default 0.8
options.follow: Follow time behind the cursor (sec), default 0.6 — 0 snaps right to it
options.wait: Wait (seconds) after the hand leaves before closing, default 0.2 — so it does not flicker when moving between rows
options.every: Photo advance interval (seconds), default 0.5 — 0 means no advancing
options.--fx-filter: Photo filter (via style), default grayscale(1) — use none to keep the original color

note: On touch devices (no hover) the box is hidden and no blur is applied. The box is position: fixed, so do not put it inside an ancestor that has a transform. As in the original, the mouse position is saved in localStorage (kfFxLastMouse), and on the first scroll before the mouse moves, the box is moved to that spot.

from.where: index.html .hm-gal (gallery with five large category words + 320px black-and-white photo box, five per group) — original gallery link list
